items.title: jiwoochris/artex-ko
items.excerpt: ARTEX 한국어판 · AI 자율 침투 테스트 프레임워크(upstream: Autumn-27/ARTEX, AGPL-3.0)
items.summary: Author presents ARTEX, described as an AI autonomous penetration testing framework, with a Korean language variant based on upstream Autumn-27/ARTEX under AGPL-3.0.
items.usefulness: Could serve as a reference for understanding how agents are designed to operate autonomously within security contexts, relevant to AI governance study.
items.to_verify: What specific autonomous capabilities ARTEX demonstrates; whether it has been peer-reviewed or deployed in production security testing.
